description: OVIXEA crystallizes in the monoclinic crystal system with space group P 21/n. Reported CIF formula moiety: C57 H64 Dy3 N8 O15,2(C2 H3 N1). From the CIF bond table, Dy1 (Dy) has 5 O neighbors; Dy2 (Dy) has 5 O neighbors; Dy3 (Dy) has 6 O neighbors. Oxygen-bridged metal-site graph: 1 pairs, 2 components; largest component is a chain with insufficient metal sites for a 3D shape classification. Computed bridged metal-metal separations span 4.187-4.187 Å (not direct metal-metal bonds). Computed M-O-M angles span 138.79-138.79°; individual values and O labels are in metal_framework.links. Article card reports molecular formula C57H64Dy3N8O15·2(C2H3N). Explicit grouped units in the article formula/name: 1 μ2-OH (explicit grouped unit in article compound name (structural notation)). Article name explicitly identifies Dy(III).
interpretation_limit: Oxidation states, nuclearity, oxo/hydroxo bridging, core charge and ligand identities/counts require article/SI or manual verification; atom-site counts are asymmetric-unit counts, not molecular stoichiometry. Graph topology is limited to identity-symmetry bonds in the CIF table. Approximate shape is based only on bridge-unwrapped metal-site coordinates in the largest component; symmetry-related bonds or periodic structures require manual crystallographic review. Empirical formulas alone do not establish unique oxidation-state assignments or ligand connectivity; annotations above reproduce explicit structural notation only.
